title: Circle-interval control of critical-density transfer times in totally ergodic countable abelian actions
author: Michael Björklund; Alexander Fish; Ilya D. Shkredov
work: Sets of transfer times with small densities
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 8 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.147
difficulty_reason: The cited compact action-set factor theorem and Kneser critical-pair theorem do not alone identify the original action's full transfer-time set or its endpoints. The author establishes a measurable transfer-time correspondence with a quantitative overshoot inequality and uses equality of the densities to recover the actual circle factor and sets. This additional correspondence shows precisely why only the two endpoint kernel cosets can differ from the inverse circle difference interval.
